name: rollout-plan
title: Rollout plan
description: What happens after you sign: a timeline from day one to day ninety, with who does what at each point.
docs: Pass title, description, milestones (four to six, each with a time label such as Day 1 or Week 2, a title, a sentence and an owner of us, you or both) and optionally a note for the fine print about what the dates assume. The first milestone is marked Start and the last Outcome, in words under its time label; flag another milestone with outcome to move the payoff. The time labels and owners are text, and the spine is a hairline between a filled start, open markers and a filled outcome, never an image, so order and ownership read without colour. On a wide section the heading sits beside the plan and each row has three columns (time, spine, milestone); on a phone the time label stacks above the title. It is an ordered list, so a screen reader announces each step's position. labels translates the fixed words, so Us and You can read Halcyon and Your team.
